line: Forgive yourself for one small thing today.
paragraph: The coconut palm is often called the Tree of 1,000 Uses. At Faith Christian Academy in Micronesia, the school is adding a new use for the fruit. The academy accepts coconuts instead of tuition payments to help families with their costs. This makes use of the many coconuts that pile up on the islands. The school year continues for every student.
